archetype: Archetype 1 (Organic & Earthy). Mapped existing 'teal' requirement to a deep, grounded Pine Teal to maintain warmth and trust, avoiding clinical UI.

surface_alt.usage: Empty states, subtle backgrounds, availability summary

primary_accent.usage: The 'teal' accent—deepened to Pine Teal for CTA buttons, active states, and the Up Next widget

hierarchy.h1: text-3xl md:text-4xl tracking-tight leading-none text-text_main font-medium
hierarchy.label: text-xs tracking-[0.2em] uppercase text-text_muted

layout_and_spacing.strategy: The 'Control Room' Grid (Dashboard Mode) customized for breathing room.
layout_and_spacing.grid_container: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-6 lg:gap-8 p-4 md:p-8 lg:p-12

left_column.content: Calendar Widget (top), 7-Day Agenda (bottom). Flex column with gap-8.

right_column.content: Up Next Widget (top), Active Jobs (middle), Availability Summary (bottom). Flex column with gap-6.

calendar.surface_strategy: Flat Solid. bg-white border border-border rounded-2xl p-6 lg:p-8.
calendar.grid: Subtle 1px borders between days. Days outside current month use bg-surface_alt.
calendar.interactions: Hover: bg-surface_alt. Selected day: ring-2 ring-primary_accent.

agenda_7_day.surface_strategy: Flat Solid. bg-white border border-border rounded-2xl p-6 lg:p-8.
agenda_7_day.list_items: py-4 border-b border-border last:border-0. Flex row: Date (left), Job Details (center), Message/Cancel Actions (right).

up_next_widget.surface_strategy: Neumorphism / High-Contrast. bg-primary_accent text-white rounded-2xl p-6.
up_next_widget.purpose: Addresses the 'Jump to next booking' requirement.
up_next_widget.content: Label 'UP NEXT', Job Title (H3), Date/Time. 'Jump to Date' button (bg-white text-primary_accent).

active_jobs.surface_strategy: Flat Solid. bg-white border border-border rounded-2xl p-6.
active_jobs.content: List of active project-management jobs (title, number, city). Linked to project.

availability_summary.purpose: Replaces the creepy Mon-Sun matrix. Provides lightweight read-only summary.
availability_summary.content: Label 'WEEKLY AVAILABILITY', compact text 'Mon - Fri: 08:00 - 16:00'. 'Edit in Settings' link (text-sm underline).

agenda_empty.philosophy: Calm, purposeful, encouraging. Never a grid of hollow grey cells.
agenda_empty.visual: A large padded area (p-12) with the 'relaxing coffee' image as a soft background or a framed visual.

calendar_sparse.visual: When a week is empty, days look clean with a soft background, not 'disabled'. No overwhelming grey blocks.

motion_and_interactions.hover_states: All buttons must explicitly define text color on hover (e.g., hover:bg-primary_hover hover:text-white).
motion_and_interactions.drag_drop: Smooth visual feedback when dragging calendar bookings (opacity-70 on drag, highlighted drop zone).

image_urls.description: Person holding white ceramic cup with hot coffee - use as a calming visual for the 'No Appointments' empty state.

testing.data_testid_rules: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid. Examples: 'jump-next-booking-btn', 'calendar-day-[date]', 'agenda-item-[id]-cancel', 'today-reset-btn'.

instructions_to_main_agent: Execute the desktop redesign using the 12-column 'Control Room' grid layout.
Build the Left Column (col-span-8) containing the Calendar and 7-day Agenda. Ensure the agenda defaults to today and responds to calendar clicks.
Build the Right Column (col-span-4) containing the 'Up Next' widget, 'Active Jobs', and 'Availability Summary'.
Completely remove the old 'Weekly Availability' matrix. Replace it with the compact 'Availability Summary'.
Implement the 'Jump to next booking' shortcut inside the 'Up Next' widget.
Apply the earthy 'Pine Teal' accent instead of the default generic teal. Follow the Light theme colors.
Implement the calm empty state for the agenda using the provided 'relaxing coffee' image URL, avoiding any creepy empty grey cells.
Preserve existing mobile responsiveness (calendar stacks single-column on mobile).
Use standard Shadcn components (Button, Card, Calendar, etc.) but override styles to match the flat solid, roomy aesthetics described.
